run_mimic_joint_constraint_demo: run the pybullet mimic joint constraint demo to visualize gear ratios between joints
create_gear_constraint: create a gear constraint between two joints using pybullet createConstraint with JOINT_GEAR type
change_gear_ratio: change the gear ratio and max force of an existing constraint using pybullet changeConstraint
load_urdf_and_inspect_joints: load a URDF model and inspect its joints using getNumJoints and getJointInfo
set_joint_velocity_control: set joint motor control to velocity mode with zero target velocity using setJointMotorControl2
